name: layered-ai-reader
description: Cross-provider browser extension that turns long AI answers into readable layers.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:dev: NODE_ENV=development tsc --noEmit && NODE_ENV=development vite build && NODE_ENV=development vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit && vite build --config vite.firefox.config.ts && vite build --config vite.firefox.content.config.ts
